--- LAFEA §10.1 geometry topology check ---
✅ LINE/ARC length, exact analytic midside points and full-circle area are correct.
✅ A square region with a circular hole computes exact net area via Green's theorem.
✅ A loop whose curves do not close end-to-end is rejected.
✅ Orientation is validated, never silently normalized (outer CCW, hole CW required).
✅ Unresolved vertex, curve and loop references are rejected by name.
✅ Feature tags resolve against the topology and reject duplicates/unresolved entities.
✅ Shell-midsurface declaration resolves its region and never computes normals itself.
✅ Topology hashing is deterministic and the canonical topology is deeply frozen.

✅ LAFEA §10.1 geometry topology check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.1 healing preview/accept check ---
✅ previewHealing finds exactly the one near-duplicate vertex pair within tolerance.
✅ previewHealing proposes candidates without mutating or re-hashing the source topology.
✅ acceptHealing applies exactly the previewed merges and produces a re-hashed topology.
✅ acceptHealing rejects a preview that does not match the topology's current hash.
✅ Accepting an empty preview is a true no-op.

✅ LAFEA §10.1 healing preview/accept check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.3 mesh quality gate check ---
✅ Aspect ratio: OK<warn(3), WARNING in [3,10), BLOCK at/above 10.
✅ Minimum triangle angle: OK>warn(25°), WARNING in (10°,25°], BLOCK at/below 10°.
✅ Scaled Jacobian: OK for well-shaped elements, BLOCK for skewed/inverted ones; always positive-checked.
✅ Shell warpage: 0° for a flat quad, OK for a small lift, BLOCK for a large one.
✅ Hole circumference: >=16 quadratic edges for production, >=24 for code SCL regions.
✅ Attachment/weld footprint edge: >=12 elements around the closed footprint.
✅ Shell element size near attachments: WARNING outside the 0.5t-2t default band.
✅ worstStatus aggregates BLOCK > WARNING > OK across a mixed gate result set.

✅ LAFEA §10.3 mesh quality gate check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.4 convergence quantities check ---
✅ Exactly the six declared quantities are accepted convergence quantities.
✅ A raw singular peak is rejected as a convergence quantity, never silently coerced.
✅ Default §10.3 acceptance limits (2%/1%/0.5%/3%/3%/5%) apply per quantity and are overridable.
✅ MONOTONIC/OSCILLATORY/NON_CONVERGENT behavior is classified from the full history, not just the last two levels.
✅ A single non-convergent quantity blocks auto-acceptance of the whole convergence set.
✅ A quantity history with fewer than 3 mesh levels is rejected.
PASS: roundoff boundaries, physical reversals, unit scaling, limits and immutable histories.

✅ LAFEA §10.4 convergence quantities check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.4 minimum mesh-level-count check ---
✅ 3 or more mesh levels are accepted without needing an exemption.
✅ Fewer than 3 mesh levels is rejected when no exemption is supplied.
✅ A validated benchmark-template exemption allows fewer than 3 levels, explicitly flagged as exempted.
✅ An incomplete exemption record is rejected, not silently accepted.

✅ LAFEA §10.4 minimum mesh-level-count check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.2 T6 mesh generation check ---
✅ Default mesh output is T6-only, and total meshed area exactly matches the true square area (100).
✅ A concave (L-shape) boundary triangulates to its exact net area — ear-clipping handles non-convex regions correctly.
✅ Every generated element has a positive Jacobian at every corner (spec §10.3: "Positive at every integration point").
✅ A region with holes is explicitly rejected rather than silently mis-triangulated (disclosed scope limit).
✅ An unresolved region is rejected by name.

✅ LAFEA §10.2 T6 mesh generation check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.2 Q8 recombination check ---
✅ Recombination never happens unless the region is explicitly declared structured.
✅ A structured region recombines into a mix of Q8/T6 elements with exactly preserved total area.
✅ Every element (T6 and recombined Q8) has a positive scaled Jacobian.
✅ Q8 recombination is deterministic (byte-identical across repeated runs).

✅ LAFEA §10.2 Q8 recombination check passed.


--- LAFEA §10.2 mapped mesh check ---
✅ An axis-aligned rectangle produces an exact structured Q8 grid, unit Jacobian, exact area.
✅ A curved boundary blends smoothly to a positive-Jacobian mesh everywhere.
✅ Mismatched opposite-side point counts are rejected — the caller falls back to triangular meshing, never a silently degraded map.
✅ Non-coincident declared corners between adjacent boundary chains are rejected.

✅ LAFEA §10.2 mapped mesh check passed.

LAFEA §10.3 mesh-quality panel (core + workspace governed metrics, verbatim rendering, BLOCK never softened, fail-closed inputs) passed.
